# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Graphia (such as path traversal vulnerabilities or memory boundary issues), please do not open a public issue.

Instead, please report security issues privately via GitHub Security Advisories or by contacting the maintainers directly.
